ClosedLoopGoalRollup.description:
Aggregated goal achievement for a closed loop (PR2).

The rollup computes:
- ``goalCount``: total goals scoped to the loop (direct + indirect).
- ``achievedCount``: goals whose latest ``currentValue`` satisfies the
  target direction.
- ``achievementPercent``: ``achievedCount / goalCount`` (0..100), or 0
  when ``goalCount`` is 0.
- ``goals``: the per-goal evaluation rows (latest value vs target).
- ``computedAt``: server-side timestamp.
ClosedLoopGoalRollup.title: ClosedLoopGoalRollup

LinkKind.description:
Topology of a relationship between two closed loops.

- ``DAISY_CHAIN``: source.target feeds source.source (linear topology).
- ``HIERARCHICAL``: source is parent of target (parent supervises child).
- ``FEEDBACK``: target feeds back into source (closes the outer loop).
- ``SHADOW``: target is a shadow / replica used for failover.

get.description:
Compute a goal achievement rollup for the closed loop.

Aggregates goals from:
- the closed loop's own ``goals`` array (CLOSED_LOOP scope with scopeRef matching the loop id)
- any workflow the loop references (WORKFLOW scope)
- any activity those workflows reference (ACTIVITY scope)

Each goal is evaluated against its target direction. The endpoint
returns 404 if the closed loop does not exist.
get.summary: Aggregate goal achievement across a closed loop and all of its child resources
